patch:
@@ -25,6 +34,10 @@
       promote:
         type: string
-        required: true
+        required: false
+      snapshot:
+        description: A dev snapshot version to publish to the gate dist-tag; dispatch on main
+        type: string
+        required: false
 
 jobs:
   ci-green:
@@ -36,5 +49,14 @@
   ci-green:
-    if: github.event_name == 'release'
+    if: github.event_name == 'release' || inputs.snapshot != ''
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Stamp the snapshot version
+        if: inputs.snapshot != ''
+        run: node scripts/stamp-version.mjs "${{ inputs.snapshot }}"
+      - name: Publish to gate
+        run: npm publish --tag gate
+      - name: Check latest did not move
+        run: npm view cairn-cms dist-tags --json
 
   publish:

@@ -10,6 +10,10 @@
 on:
   workflow_dispatch:
     inputs:
+      snapshot:
+        description: A dev snapshot version for the launcher and its platform packages
+        type: string
+        required: false
   release:
     types: [published]
